# `compat/healers/gpu-healer.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/healers/gpu-healer.js`

healers/gpu-healer.js — normalise GPU-related profile fields before boot. Sets a sensible `gpu.presentation` and ensures the runtime healing flags the interposer relies on (`clampGpuLimits`, `wrapQueueSubmit`) are populated. The actual limit-clamping happens at runtime in `interposers/gpu.js`.

## Functions

### `healGpu({ profile }, report)`

healers/gpu-healer.js — normalise GPU-related profile fields before boot. Sets a sensible `gpu.presentation` and ensures the runtime healing flags the interposer relies on (`clampGpuLimits`, `wrapQueueSubmit`) are populated. The actual limit-clamping happens at runtime in `interposers/gpu.js`.
